# `satl run` { #satl-run }

Create and run a new container from an image

```console
$ satl run [OPTIONS] <IMAGE> [COMMAND]...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;IMAGE&gt;</code> | Image to run |
| <code>[COMMAND]...</code> | Command and arguments to run in the container |

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-d, --detach</code> | Run the container in the background and print its ID |
| <code>--name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Assign a name to the container |
| <code>-p, --publish &lt;LIST&gt;</code> | Publish a container's port(s) to the host: [ip:][hostPort:]containerPort[/protocol]. The ip is accepted but not honored yet (a warning is printed). |
| <code>-v, --volume &lt;LIST&gt;</code> | Bind mount a volume: [source:]target[:ro\|:rw]. The source is a host path or a volume name; an omitted source creates an anonymous volume. |
| <code>--tmpfs &lt;MOUNT&gt;</code> | Mount a tmpfs directory: /path[:options]. |
| <code>-e, --env &lt;KEY=VALUE&gt;</code> | Set environment variables |
| <code>--env-file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Read environment variables from a file |
| <code>-w, --workdir &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Working directory inside the container |
| <code>-u, --user &lt;USER&gt;</code> | Username or UID |
| <code>--hostname &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Container host name |
| <code>-m, --memory &lt;BYTES&gt;</code> | Memory limit, with an optional binary unit suffix: 512m, 1g, 2.5g, or a plain byte count. Enforced through rctl(8). |
| <code>--cpus &lt;DECIMAL&gt;</code> | Number of CPUs; fractions allowed (0.5, 1.25). Enforced through rctl(8). |
| <code>--restart &lt;POLICY&gt;</code> | Restart policy to apply when a container exits: no, on-failure[:max] or always. |
| <code>--platform &lt;PLATFORM&gt;</code> | Set platform if the image is multi-platform capable |
| <code>--rm</code> | Automatically remove the container when it exits |
| <code>-l, --label &lt;KEY=VALUE&gt;</code> | Set metadata on the container |
| <code>--entrypoint &lt;COMMAND&gt;</code> | Overwrite the default entrypoint of the image |
| <code>--pull &lt;PULL&gt;</code> | Pull image before running<br>Values: <code>always</code> — Always pull before creating; <code>missing</code> — Pull only when the daemon says the image is missing (default); <code>never</code> — Never pull; a missing image is an error<br>Default: <code>missing</code> |
| <code>-i, --interactive</code> | Keep STDIN open even if not attached |
| <code>-t, --tty</code> | Allocate a pseudo-TTY (not supported yet) |

## Global options { #global-options }

Accepted by every `satl` command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--host &lt;URL&gt;</code> | Daemon socket to connect to (docker-style URL)<br>Default: <code>unix:///var/run/satl.sock</code><br>Environment: <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> |
| <code>-h, --help</code> | Print help |
| <code>-V, --version</code> | Print version |
